name: Mac Power Users forum: Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals thread
accepts: Mac and iOS app deals, posted by readers. A yearly thread (2026: https://talk.macpowerusers.com/t/black-friday-and-cyber-monday-deals-2026/48135).
how_to_submit: Post once in the thread from a forum account.
rules: FAQ rule 3: 'It's totally cool to share what you're working on, just be mindful not to overdo it.' Also: 'Things are not to be listed for sale in the Forum', no affiliate links, and give context for shared links.
Rule 6: the forum has no For Sale category.
As of 19 Nov 2026 no poster in the thread had posted their own app; readers listed aggregators instead.
